device.category: 8-note polyphonic analogue synthesizer, 61 keys with velocity and per-key aftertouch, two channels per note, ribbon controller
device.based_on: Original design, 1977; Yamaha's flagship of the CS series (CS-50, CS-60, CS-80) after the GX-1.

sources.title: Yamaha CS-80 Polyphonic Synthesizer Instruction Manual
sources.note: Scanned with a rough OCR layer; Section IV (technical control descriptions, controls [1]-[46]), block diagrams text, specifications and ribbon section read.

architecture.polyphony_mode: 8 notes; each note drives channel I and channel II together (16 VCOs, VCFs, VCAs and EG sets), blended by the MIX lever
architecture.patch_memory_note: No electronic memory. Each channel offers 11 fixed presets, two memories and one programmable panel; the four memories are miniature physical copies of the panel controls under a cover, so 'storing' means setting tiny sliders by hand.
architecture.summary: Two channels per note. Each channel: a sawtooth VCO whose wave shape converter gives square (with PWM from its own sub oscillator), sawtooth and sine, plus white noise; a high-pass and a low-pass filter in series with separate resonance, moved by an IL/AL/A/D/R envelope; the sine bypasses the filter into the VCA, which has an ADSR. Velocity (INITIAL) and per-key pressure (AFTER) raise brilliance and level. Shared controls blend the channels, detune channel II, offset brilliance and resonance, scale brightness and level across the keyboard, add velocity pitchbend and pressure-controlled sub-oscillator modulation, plus a global sub oscillator, ring modulator, sustain, portamento/glissando, tremolo/chorus (rotary-speaker-like in stereo) and a ribbon controller.

modules.name: Channel I VCO
modules.description: Sawtooth VCO with wave shape converter: square (variable PW, PWM), sawtooth, sine; FEET sets the range.

modules.name: Channel I PWM oscillator
modules.description: Pulse-width modulation oscillator (SPEED, PWM depth).

modules.name: Channel I noise
modules.description: White noise into the VCO mix.

modules.name: Channel I VCO mix
modules.description: Square and sawtooth (switched on/off) plus noise level into the filters.

modules.name: Channel I VCF (HPF + LPF)
modules.description: High-pass then low-pass filter, each with cutoff and resonance (RES H, RES L); cutoffs moved together by the filter EG, brilliance and touch.

modules.name: Channel I filter EG (IL-AL-A-D-R)
modules.description: Starts from IL (below the set cutoffs), rises over A to AL (above), decays over D to the set cutoffs, releases over R back to IL. Attack 1 ms-1 s; decay and release 10 ms-10 s.

modules.name: Channel I VCA
modules.description: Mixes the filtered signal (VCF LEVEL) with the unfiltered sine (SINE WAVE LEVEL); ADSR envelope; LEVEL sets the maximum.

modules.name: Channel I VCA EG (ADSR)
modules.description: Attack 1 ms-1 s, decay and release 10 ms-10 s, sustain level.

modules.name: Channel II VCO
modules.description: Sawtooth VCO with wave shape converter: square (variable PW, PWM), sawtooth, sine; FEET sets the range.

modules.name: Channel II PWM oscillator
modules.description: Pulse-width modulation oscillator (SPEED, PWM depth).

modules.name: Channel II noise
modules.description: White noise into the VCO mix.

modules.name: Channel II VCO mix
modules.description: Square and sawtooth (switched on/off) plus noise level into the filters.

modules.name: Channel II VCF (HPF + LPF)
modules.description: High-pass then low-pass filter, each with cutoff and resonance (RES H, RES L); cutoffs moved together by the filter EG, brilliance and touch.

modules.name: Channel II filter EG (IL-AL-A-D-R)
modules.description: Starts from IL (below the set cutoffs), rises over A to AL (above), decays over D to the set cutoffs, releases over R back to IL. Attack 1 ms-1 s; decay and release 10 ms-10 s.

modules.name: Channel II VCA
modules.description: Mixes the filtered signal (VCF LEVEL) with the unfiltered sine (SINE WAVE LEVEL); ADSR envelope; LEVEL sets the maximum.

modules.name: Channel II VCA EG (ADSR)
modules.description: Attack 1 ms-1 s, decay and release 10 ms-10 s, sustain level.

modules.name: Keyboard and note assigner
modules.description: 61 keys with velocity (INITIAL) and individual key pressure (AFTER); digital assignment of 8 notes to the voice boards; sustain and portamento/glissando.

modules.name: Ribbon controller
modules.description: Touch anywhere as the reference and slide: up to about an octave sharp to the right, far wider downward (into sub-audio).

modules.name: Channel MIX
modules.description: Blends channel I and II for each note into the shared processing.

modules.name: Sub oscillator
modules.description: Sine, sawtooth, inverted sawtooth, square, white noise or external input, applied equally to all voices' VCO, VCF and VCA by depth levers.

modules.name: Ring modulator
modules.description: Sine-wave ring modulation of both channels and all notes; SPEED, MODULATION depth, and an attack/decay envelope (DEPTH) on the speed.

modules.name: Tremolo / chorus
modules.description: Amplitude and phase modulation: TREMOLO, or slower CHORUS; with the L and R outputs, a rotary-speaker-like effect.

modules.name: Outputs
modules.description: VOLUME and foot controller (expression or expression/wah); LEFT, RIGHT and GENERAL (mono) outputs, headphones; HIGH/LOW level switch.

modules.name: Foot controller
modules.description: Expression pedal: volume (EXP), or volume plus a resonant HPF/LPF sweep (EXP/WAH).

parameters.label: PW I
parameters.function: Square duty cycle, 50% to a 90% pulse.

parameters.label: IL I
parameters.function: Initial level: how far below the set cutoffs the filters start.

parameters.label: AL I
parameters.function: Attack level: how far above the set cutoffs the filters rise.

parameters.label: LEVEL I
parameters.function: Maximum VCA level (master for the channel).

parameters.label: AFTER-BRILLIANCE I
parameters.function: Key pressure raises the filter cutoffs.

parameters.label: TONE SELECTOR I
parameters.function: Selects the channel's voice: a preset, a memory or the programmable panel (lit button; one per row).
parameters.note: 21 preset names across both rows; 11 presets per row per the specifications.

parameters.label: FEET I
parameters.note: Range 16'-2' from the specifications; intermediate footages (e.g. 5-1/3') are mentioned.

parameters.label: PW II
parameters.function: Square duty cycle, 50% to a 90% pulse.

parameters.label: IL II
parameters.function: Initial level: how far below the set cutoffs the filters start.

parameters.label: AL II
parameters.function: Attack level: how far above the set cutoffs the filters rise.

parameters.label: LEVEL II
parameters.function: Maximum VCA level (master for the channel).

parameters.label: AFTER-BRILLIANCE II
parameters.function: Key pressure raises the filter cutoffs.

parameters.label: TONE SELECTOR II
parameters.function: Selects the channel's voice: a preset, a memory or the programmable panel (lit button; one per row).
parameters.note: 21 preset names across both rows; 11 presets per row per the specifications.

parameters.label: FEET II
parameters.note: Range 16'-2' from the specifications; intermediate footages (e.g. 5-1/3') are mentioned.

parameters.label: MIX I - II
parameters.function: Channel I only, a blend, or channel II only.

parameters.label: DETUNE CH II
parameters.function: Detunes channel II by about ±1 semitone against channel I.

parameters.label: BRILLIANCE
parameters.function: Offsets both filters' cutoffs for all voices (pull down = brighter).

parameters.label: RESONANCE
parameters.function: Adds resonance to both filters (pull down = more).

parameters.label: KEYBOARD CONTROL BRILL LOW
parameters.function: Gradually brightens or darkens the lower end of the keyboard.

parameters.label: KEYBOARD CONTROL BRILL HIGH
parameters.function: Gradually brightens or darkens the upper end of the keyboard.

parameters.label: KEYBOARD CONTROL LEVEL LOW
parameters.function: Gradually raises or lowers the level of the lower end of the keyboard.

parameters.label: KEYBOARD CONTROL LEVEL HIGH
parameters.function: Gradually raises or lowers the level of the upper end of the keyboard.

parameters.label: TOUCH RESPONSE PITCHBEND
parameters.function: Velocity-sensitive: notes start flat and slide up to pitch; harder playing bends more.

parameters.label: TOUCH RESPONSE SPEED (after)
parameters.function: Pressure raises the sub oscillator speed.

parameters.label: TOUCH RESPONSE VCO (after)
parameters.function: Pressure adds sub-oscillator modulation to the VCOs (vibrato).

parameters.label: TOUCH RESPONSE VCF (after)
parameters.function: Pressure adds sub-oscillator modulation to the filters.

parameters.label: SUB OSCILLATOR SPEED
parameters.function: Rate of the sine, saw or square.

parameters.label: SUB OSCILLATOR VCO
parameters.function: Modulation depth to the VCOs (vibrato, wah, tremolo).

parameters.label: SUB OSCILLATOR VCF
parameters.function: Modulation depth to the VCFs (vibrato, wah, tremolo).

parameters.label: SUB OSCILLATOR VCA
parameters.function: Modulation depth to the VCAs (vibrato, wah, tremolo).

parameters.label: RING MODULATOR DEPTH
parameters.function: Amount of envelope on the speed.

parameters.label: SUSTAIN
parameters.function: Die-away after release, up to about 10 s.

parameters.label: SUSTAIN FOOT SWITCH
parameters.function: On: the foot switch turns sustain on/off; off: sustain always on.

parameters.label: SUSTAIN I - II
parameters.function: I: each note sustains independently; II: a new note or chord ends the previous sustain.
parameters.note: The manual's description of modes I and II is partly illegible in the scan.

parameters.label: PORTAMENTO / GLISSANDO
parameters.function: Glide time, up to 10 s across the keyboard.

parameters.label: P/G FOOT SWITCH
parameters.function: On: the foot switch turns the effect on/off; off: always on.

parameters.label: FOOT PEDAL SELECTOR
parameters.function: EXP (volume) or EXP/WAH (volume plus resonant filter sweep).

parameters.label: RIBBON CONTROLLER
parameters.function: Pitch bend for all notes while held.
parameters.note: Callout number not legible in the scan.

ports.label: HEADPHONES
ports.function: Stereo headphones, 250 mV; physically on the bottom panel.

ports.label: EXT IN
ports.function: External signal as the sub-oscillator source (50 kohm, 10 mV rms nominal), with level control.

ports.label: FOOT SWITCH
ports.function: Sustain and/or portamento on/off (per the assigners).

ports.label: AC
ports.function: AC 50/60 Hz, 180 W; cord stored under the instrument.

connections.note: Velocity pitchbend: start flat, slide to pitch.
Keyboard control brilliance tilts the cutoffs across the keyboard.
Wah: sweeps HPF and LPF and adds resonance.

indicators.label: TONE SELECTOR lamps
indicators.function: Show the selected voice in each row.

behaviours.name: Two channels per note
behaviours.rule: Every key sounds channel I and channel II (each a full VCO-VCF-VCA voice) on its own voice board; up to 8 notes and 16 voices. Each channel picks a preset, memory or the panel; MIX balances them; DETUNE CH II thickens them.

behaviours.name: Filter envelope
behaviours.rule: IL-AL-A-D-R: on a key the HPF and LPF start IL below their set cutoffs, move over the attack time to AL above, decay to the set cutoffs and, on release, move back to IL over the release time. With IL and AL at zero the envelope does nothing.

behaviours.name: Sine bypass
behaviours.rule: Square, sawtooth and noise pass the filters (VCF LEVEL); the sine goes straight to the VCA (SINE WAVE LEVEL), so pure fundamentals can be mixed with filtered tones.

behaviours.name: Touch response
behaviours.rule: Per channel: velocity (INITIAL) and per-key pressure (AFTER) raise brilliance and level. Shared: velocity pitchbend (notes slide up into pitch), and pressure raising the sub-oscillator speed or its modulation of the VCOs and VCFs, note by note.

behaviours.name: Ribbon controller
behaviours.rule: Touch anywhere as the reference and slide: about an octave sharp at most, but much further flat (down to sub-audio). In sustain mode II the ribbon also bends sustaining notes after release.

behaviours.name: Sustain and portamento
behaviours.rule: Sustain up to about 10 s; portamento or semitone glissando up to 10 s across the keyboard. Foot-switch assigners decide which the switch controls (or leave them always on).

behaviours.name: Memories
behaviours.rule: No electronic memory: four miniature control panels (two per channel) under the memory cover duplicate the programmable panel's controls; patches are copied by eye and fine-tuned by ear.

behaviours.name: Global effects
behaviours.rule: The sub oscillator (sine, saw, inverted saw, square, noise or external input) modulates all voices' VCO, VCF and VCA; the ring modulator processes the summed output with an envelope on its speed; tremolo/chorus adds amplitude and phase modulation, rotary-like in stereo.

midi.note: None: the CS-80 predates MIDI (retrofits exist).

specifications.keyboard: 61 keys, C-C, velocity and polyphonic pressure
specifications.envelopes: attack 1 ms-1 s, decay/release 10 ms-10 s
specifications.presets: 11 per channel (STRING 1-4, BRASS 1-3, FLUTE, ELECTRIC PIANO, BASS, CLAVICHORD, HARPSICHORD 1-2, ORGAN 1-2, GUITAR 1-2, FUNKY 1-4)

source_inconsistencies: The specifications say each channel has 11 presets (22 in all) but the legible list gives 21 names; a stray '(1 & 2)' in the scan suggests one name was lost to OCR.
The specifications say 'Each channel is provided with 11 different preset patches, two memory-programmable patches', while the memory section describes 'Memories 1-4'; these are two per channel.
The overview says the CS-80 has 16 sets of VCO/VCF/VCA/EG; the block diagram labels the voice boards M1-M8 (one board per note carrying both channels).

modelling_gaps.detail: The scan's text layer is rough; values are taken where legible and some callout numbers are inferred.
Memory panels are physical miniature controls; modelled as a tone-selector choice, not as stored parameters.
Channel I and II voice modules are per_voice (one per note); MIX, sub oscillator, ring mod, tremolo and outputs are common.
